function.name: schedule_event
function.description: Schedule a one-time event or reminder. Use this when the user asks to set a reminder or schedule an event.

message.description: Exact text Atlas should say when the reminder fires.

offset_minutes.description: Minutes from now. Use for duration-based reminders.

time.description: 12-hour clock time, exactly h:mm AM or h:mm PM.

function.name: list_scheduled_events
function.description: List all scheduled events. Use this when the user asks about reminders or scheduled events.

function.name: cancel_scheduled_event
function.description: Cancel a scheduled event by event_id. Use this after identifying the event with list_scheduled_events if the user wants to cancel a reminder or scheduled event.

event_id.description: The event_id returned by schedule_event or list_scheduled_events.

function.name: acknowledge_notification
function.description: Acknowledge the active reminder after the user clearly says they completed, handled, dismissed, or no longer wants that reminder.

notification_id.description: The exact ID of the active reminder notification.

function.name: get_current_datetime
function.description: Get the current date, time, and day of week. Use this for questions about the current time, date, day, month, or year.

function.name: get_light_status
function.description: Get whether the lights in a room are currently on or off. Use this when the user asks about current light status.

function.name: set_light
function.description: Turn the lights in a room on or off. Use only when the user clearly asks to change the lights. If the user asks to change all rooms, call this tool once for each room.

power.description: Whether the lights should be on or off.
